_meta.purpose: TEMPLATE. Personal indicators: the static profile (sex / year of birth / height) plus manual metrics such as waist. PERSONAL.
_meta.how_to_fill: profile: sex, year of birth, height — the «Lifestyle» tab → profile. Manual metrics (waist) — the «Waist, cm» field. BMI is computed from the height and the latest weight.
_meta.shape: profile: { sex('male'|'female'), birth_year:int, height_cm:number }; metrics: { <key>: { name, unit, direction?, series:[{date, value}] } }
_meta.why_empty: `profile` ships EMPTY on purpose. Sex, age and height enter the biological-age panels and the BMI; a default sex and year of birth would put someone else's body into your results without saying so. Anything that needs them refuses to answer until you fill them in — which is the correct answer, not a defect.
